hero.title: Precision Knitwear & Sweater Manufacturing Powerhouse
hero.subtitle: ASDWA Fashion Ltd. operates 550+ computerized flat knitting machines, uniting European engineering standards with 2,500+ master artisans across a unified 12-acre sustainable campus.
hero.hero_card_1_text: 553+ Shima Seiki & Stoll flat knitting machines under one unified roof in Narsingdi
hero.hero_card_2_text: Trusted production partner for Zara, Mango, Pull&Bear, Bershka, and Oysho
hero.hero_card_3_text: GOTS, GRS, RCS, RWS, OEKO-TEX & BSCI certified with 100% daytime rooftop solar

about.story_text_1: ASDWA Fashion Ltd. is a premier export-oriented readymade garment (RMG) manufacturer specializing in high-end sweaters and knitwear. Operating from Madhabdi, Narsingdi and corporate headquarters in Mohakhali DOHS, Dhaka, we combine state-of-the-art Japanese and German knitting technology with over two decades of technical mastery.
about.story_bullet_1_text: Over 20 years of relentless dedication to gauge precision, fiber integrity, and timely global exports
about.story_bullet_2_text: 553+ flat knitting machines spanning 1.5GG to 14GG with annual production exceeding 8.5 million units
about.story_bullet_3_text: Complete vertical oversight from yarn lab testing, computerized knitting, and dial linking to eco-washing and AQL 1.5 inspection
about.why_title: Why Global Brands Partner with ASDWA
about.why_intro: Global fashion retailers choose ASDWA Fashion Ltd. because we eliminate intermediaries. Our buyers communicate directly with technical manufacturing specialists who manage every needle, yarn lot, and wash treatment.
about.why_1_text: From ultra-chunky fisherman cables and heavy 3GG cardigans to ultra-fine 14GG babywear and cashmere blends
about.why_2_text: Our own 12-acre unified facility in Narsingdi guarantees yarn lot consistency, seam integrity, and rock-solid delivery dates
about.why_3_text: Rooftop solar power, closed-loop water treatment, and internationally audited GOTS, GRS, and BSCI compliance
about.why_4_text: Direct design and commercial coordination offices in Barcelona, Prato, Tokyo, Shanghai, and New York
about.why_5_text: On-site medical clinic with licensed doctors, nursery daycare for working mothers, and fair living wages
about.sample_text: Our dedicated sampling wing features high-speed prototyping machines and a physical yarn archive of over 450 certified fibers, turning creative designs into production-ready samples in as fast as 72 hours.
about.sample_1_text: Dedicated prototyping flat machines covering gauges 3GG through 14GG for rapid iteration without stopping bulk production lines
about.sample_2_text: Accelerated turnaround for urgent runway developments, collection revisions, and colorway approvals
about.sample_4_text: In-house lab verifying yarn tensile strength, color fastness, pilling resistance, and dimensional stability
about.sample_5_text: Virtual knit development minimizing physical yarn waste and cutting sample development carbon footprint by 65%
about.sample_6_text: Direct collaboration between brand designers and ASDWA's master knit technicians and programming engineers
about.teams_heading: Bangladeshi Manufacturing Power with Global Reach
about.teams_text: ASDWA Fashion Ltd. bridges local industrial scale in Bangladesh with design and client relations desks across major fashion capitals.
about.teams_closer_text: Direct access to our factory floor managers and technical engineers without third-party agent markups
about.teams_faster_text: Complete in-house control from yarn winding to steam finishing ensures zero subcontracting delays
about.teams_yarn_text: Direct partnerships with certified spinning mills across Italy, India, China, and domestic spinners
about.teams_alignment_text: Translating intricate creative moodboards into precise Shima Seiki and Stoll CAD knit files
about.production_heading: Manufacturing with Precision Engineering, Not Just Raw Capacity
about.production_text_1: Our flagship manufacturing campus in Madhabdi, Narsingdi operates 553 computerized flat knitting machines alongside automated linking tables, bio-wash tumbling drums, and calibrated lab testing apparatus.
about.production_text_2: Every garment produced at ASDWA Fashion Ltd. undergoes a rigorous 9-point quality check adhering to AQL 1.5 standards before export.
about.production_cap_1_text: State-of-the-art Shima Seiki and Stoll computerized flat knitting machines
about.production_cap_2_text: Full chemical, wash, shrinkage, seam tension, and color crocking testing equipment
about.production_cap_3_text: Clean seams from 3GG to 18GG ensuring superior garment drape and durability
about.production_cap_4_text: Low-liquor washing drums with organic bio-softening enzymes and water recycling
about.production_cap_5_text: 9-point metal detection ensuring 100% infant and children wear consumer safety
about.production_cap_6_text: Robust production planning built for large seasonal bulk orders and flexible quick-response runs
about.production_text_6: Scalable industrial knitwear production without compromising quality, ethical integrity, or lead time.

manufacturing.hero_sub: Our 12-acre unified facility at Kandai, Madhabdi, Narsingdi is the manufacturing core powering international knitwear collections.
manufacturing.hero_text: Equipped with 553 computerized flat knitting machines, eco-wash bays, and 2,500+ skilled artisans, ASDWA delivers uncompromised consistency from sample to container load.
manufacturing.overview_title: Vertical Knitwear Operations Under One Roof
manufacturing.overview_text: By housing yarn conditioning, computerized flat knitting, linking, washing, steam pressing, and metal detection in one complex, ASDWA guarantees complete traceability and zero subcontracting risk.
manufacturing.cta_text: We welcome brand compliance teams, technical designers, and sourcing heads to tour our Narsingdi factory floor.

responsibility.cta_title: Partner with a Verified Ethical Manufacturer
responsibility.cta_text: ASDWA Fashion Ltd. proves that high-volume commercial apparel manufacturing and deep social-environmental responsibility can thrive together.

lyk.cta_text: Explore rapid prototyping, circular yarn alternatives, and digital 3D knit simulations with our technical team.

common.cta_text: Connect directly with our engineering team for technical specs, sample turnaround, and production allocation.
